name: Antigravity-CLI
description: Headless remote connection server for Google Antigravity. Run the autonomous DeepMind AI coding agent 24/7 on your Unraid server and seamlessly connect from your Antigravity Desktop App, IDE, or browser. Offload heavy code indexing, compiler toolchains (Python 3, Node.js, Git, build-essential, Docker CLI), and multi-agent execution directly to your server with persistent credentials and automated Google updates.

paths.name: Appdata / Config
paths.description: Container home directory. Stores persistent Google auth tokens (.gemini/), preferences, SSH keys, and shell history. TIP: For fastest performance and to bypass Unraid's FUSE (shfs) overhead, map directly to your cache pool (e.g. /mnt/cache/appdata/antigravity).

paths.name: Projects / Workspaces
paths.description: Working directory where your code repositories and Unraid shares reside for the agent to access. TIP: For fastest build, git, and indexing speeds, map directly to your cache pool (e.g. /mnt/cache/projects) or use an Exclusive Share.

paths.name: Shared Memory (RAM Buffer)
paths.description: Mounts host shared memory to prevent Chromium, headless browser tools, and compiler workers from crashing or falling back to slow disk.

paths.name: Docker Socket (Optional)
paths.description: Mount host docker socket if you want Antigravity to be able to inspect or run docker containers.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID for file ownership inside container (default 99 matches Unraid nobody user).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for file ownership inside container (default 100 matches Unraid users group).

variables.name: Instance Name
variables.description: Instance name displayed when connecting via Antigravity Remote.

variables.name: Auto Start Daemon
variables.description: Automatically launch agy remote-control background daemon on container boot.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Automatically query Google release manifests and update agy binary on container start and periodically.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Container timezone for accurate log timestamps.
